c9747f82: 
 ;
 ;DGJXE11 is the main driver for editing VAS(393 multiple fields.
 ;It handles the following:
 ; 1. Setting up variables for editing
 ; 2. Editing loops
 ; 3. Read transform
 ; 4. Processing HELP
 ; 5. Special processing for Date of Death field in Case file
 ; 6. Calls to FileMan utilities
 ;
71533cd9: ;Do setup and go to entry point of main loop
ad5bd8a4: ;Setup variables for editing data in multiple DA(-1) x-ref node.
44dc55a5: ;If Date of Death field has data, set DE(1)=Date of Death
18a3151d: ;Write data, adjust wrap for long fields.
23d356ce: ;On long fields, wrap automatically unless NoWrap parameter present
cf93391f: ;For IDENTIFIERS with no editing value, put message.
6f6a4725: ;Read in X and set timeout trap.
7211dcc8: ;'N' entry-point to loop back and edit same entry.
37ec3ae4: ;Kill previous entry and get next entry.
e1092087: ;Re-edit same entry if help routine asks for it.
01c6ff54: ;On null response, loop or quit based on parameter settings.
49b943a7: ;if @ was entered check for stored value
c9b770df: ;If not one of other options, then do lookup on DIC for VALUE input.
ddf62630: ;On VALUE'' match, lookup all values.
486a650a: ;On failure to match fully, write partial match and loop.
6dc75443: ;If LAYGO specified and global involved, lookup file.
2458b46f: ;Massage decimal point and pad leading 0 on legal input
ecbf0f0e: ;Get current date/time, strip time portion.
2835fa5f: ;Branch to input transform for DATE DICTATED field.
b2ca964f: ;If blank response, clear DATE TRANSCRIBED.
f3b4e302: ;Branch to input transform for DATE TRANSCRIBED field.
5e3d028e: ;If DATE TRANSCRIBED before DATE DICTATED, display error message, clear DATE TRANSMIT, set Y to force re-entry of date.
4f9b4c91: ;Branch to input transform for DICTATOR field.
58c5c7a3: ;If blank response, set DICTATOR to 'DICTATED', set Y to force re-entry of value.
f286ebde: ;Branch to continuation of input routine.
